core: Cellular heat and oxidative stress response
qualifier: HSF1 activation plus stress granule dynamics
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
rationale: All members concern acute proteotoxic stress responses (HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, arsenite/PKR-driven stress granule assembly and disassembly); combining HSF1 control with stress granule dynamics separates it from the mRNA-decay, refolding/UPRmt and proteasome-regulation neighbours.

qualifier: methylation and pseudouridylation, mitochondrial RNA processing and ribosome assembly
name: RNA methylation, pseudouridylation and mitochondrial RNA processing
rationale: Members are tRNA/rRNA/mRNA base methylation and pseudouridine synthesis plus mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA processing and mitoribosome assembly, which distinguishes it from neighbours centred on aminoacylation and translational fidelity, mitochondrial transcription/translation, or nuclear snRNA modification.

qualifier: antral growth through ovulation and luteinization
name: Ovarian follicle development, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members describe ovarian follicle progression from antral growth to ovulation and corpus luteum formation, unlike neighbours about progesterone and luteolysis, testis and meiosis, or oocyte maturation.

qualifier: suppression of Rho/Rac and integrin signaling
name: Suppression of Rho/Rac signaling and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members inhibit Rho/Rac and integrin signaling, lamellipodia, stress fibres and cell-substrate junctions (with focal adhesion disassembly and invadopodia), whereas neighbours centre on epithelial/keratinocyte migration, EGF response and CDC42-driven protrusion.

qualifier: FRS/SHC-to-MAPK arm via FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4
name: FRS/SHC-mediated MAPK signaling by FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4
rationale: Members are FGFR1/3/4 ligand binding and FRS2- and SHC-mediated MAPK cascades, lacking the PI3K/PLCgamma arms, FGFR2-specific events and Sprouty/FGFRL1 feedback that define the neighbours.

qualifier: with thiamine and coenzyme A cofactor supply
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, thiamine and coenzyme A metabolism
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation by PDH and its regulation together with its cofactors thiamine (B1) and pantothenate/CoA, distinguishing it from NAD, lipoylation/OGDH, riboflavin and TCA-cycle neighbours.

core: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signature
qualifier: CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface receptors, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are DC/monocyte surface and antigen-presentation gene signatures together with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation, separating it from neutrophil/monocyte effector, lymphocyte surface and MHC class II peptide-presentation neighbours.

core: Mitochondrial amino acid catabolism feeding succinyl-CoA
qualifier: GABA shunt and protein lipoylation
name: GABA shunt, lysine and glycine catabolism with protein lipoylation
rationale: Members are GABA synthesis/degradation, lysine and glycine catabolism, succinyl-CoA synthesis and protein lipoylation, while neighbours are defined by the 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, DLD) themselves.

qualifier: phosphatidic acid to DAG/TAG synthesis route, not lipid droplet storage
name: Phosphatidic acid to diacylglycerol and triglyceride synthesis
rationale: All members are enzymatic steps synthesising and remodelling phosphatidic acid, mono-, di- and triacylglycerol, distinct from neighbours on lipid droplet dynamics, adipogenesis and glycerol metabolism.

qualifier: aminoacylation and anticodon (wobble, t6A) modification
name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover cytosolic/mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation, anticodon-loop modifications (wobble thiolation, t6A, wobble guanine), selenocysteine charging and translational fidelity, unlike neighbours centred on tRNA methylation, pseudouridylation, wybutosine and tRNA end processing.

qualifier: through nuclear pore complex, including NPC assembly
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly/disassembly and transport of mRNA, proteins, ribosomal subunits, tRNA and inositol phosphates through it, distinct from SUMOylation/nuclear envelope breakdown, splicing/RNA decay and ESCRT envelope sealing neighbours.

qualifier: leucine and isoleucine branch, not valine or biotin
name: Leucine and isoleucine catabolic organic acidemias
rationale: Members are leucine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism and their inborn errors (isovaleric acidemia, MCC deficiency, 3-MGA, beta-ketothiolase deficiency), whereas neighbours add valine catabolism and biotin defects.

qualifier: SWI/SNF (BAF) complex variants
name: SWI/SNF (BAF) complex assembly and nucleosome remodeling
rationale: Members are formation of the cBAF, pBAF, ncBAF, esBAF and neuronal BAF complexes plus CHD1/2 and nucleosome organisation/assembly, distinguishing it from histone acetylation, CHD6-9 and NuRD neighbours.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine and aspartate
name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
rationale: All members are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism and nitrogen utilisation, unlike neighbours on the malate-aspartate shuttle, proline/glycine metabolism, TCA intermediates and amino acid conjugation.

qualifier: TLR7/TLR8 to IRF5
name: Endosomal TLR7/TLR8 signaling to IRF5
rationale: Members are TLR7 and TLR8 signaling and SLC15A4:TASL-dependent IRF5 activation, distinct from interferon response, TLR9/IRF7 and RIG-I-like receptor neighbours.

qualifier: IL-17/Th17 with IL-33, IL-36 and IL-38
name: IL-17/Th17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-17 production/signaling, Th17 commitment and IL-33, IL-36 and IL-38 signaling, separating it from Dectin/antifungal, IL-1/IL-18 processing and IL-12/IL-23 neighbours.

qualifier: grooming and psychomotor behavior
name: Exploratory, grooming and psychomotor behavior
rationale: Members are psychomotor, swimming, grooming and locomotory exploration behaviours (with amygdala development), distinct from neighbours on adult walking/reflexes, prepulse inhibition/synaptic transmission and social or mating behaviour.

qualifier: activating domain mutants, not drug resistance
name: KIT signaling regulation and activating domain mutants
rationale: Members are regulation of KIT signaling and signaling by extracellular, juxtamembrane and kinase-domain KIT mutants, unlike neighbours on TKI-resistant KIT/PDGFR mutants and FLT3/PDGFRA oncogenic signaling.

qualifier: polyglutamylation and severing
name: Tubulin polyglutamylation and microtubule severing
rationale: Members are tubulin C-terminal glutamylation/deglutamylation and microtubule severing/depolymerisation, distinct from ciliary axoneme assembly, kinesin transport, chaperonin tubulin folding and centrosome anchoring neighbours.

qualifier: membrane transport, NTP catabolism and nucleoside-analog drugs
name: Nucleoside transport, triphosphate catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport (incl. SLC29A3), NUDT/NTP catabolism and ADME of nucleoside-analog and thiopurine drugs, distinguishing it from nucleotide interconversion and general xenobiotic efflux neighbours.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Carnitine-dependent mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketogenesis
rationale: Members are carnitine transport/shuttle, stepwise mitochondrial beta-oxidation of medium- and long-chain acyl-CoAs and ketone body synthesis/use, unlike neighbours on branched-chain/2-oxoacid catabolism, malonyl-CoA regulation and fatty acid uptake.

core: RNA and nascent protein quality control
qualifier: nuclear exosome decay, NMD and stalled-ribosome rescue
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD and stalled-ribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover nuclear RNA surveillance/exosome decay, nonsense-mediated, no-go and non-stop decay, ribosome quality control and degron-based protein degradation, distinct from neighbours on RNA polymerase I/III transcription, splicing/mRNA export, telomerase/snoRNA and translation initiation.

core: Amino acid conjugation of carboxylic acids
qualifier: glycine and glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine and glutamine conjugation of aromatic carboxylic acids
rationale: Core members are mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, with broad organic/amino acid metabolism terms sharing those genes; neighbours concern general amino acid catabolism, drug ADME or glutamate metabolism.

qualifier: aldosterone synthesis/secretion and renal sodium handling
name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members are aldosterone synthesis, secretion and response with renal sodium import, glomerular filtration and blood pressure regulation, distinct from cortisol, angiotensin, vasopressin/water and potassium-transport neighbours.

qualifier: extrinsic/common cascade, fibrin formation and fibrinolysis inhibition
name: Coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and fibrinolysis inhibition
rationale: Members are coagulation initiation, amplification and the common pathway to fibrin, platelet degranulation and inhibition of plasminogen activation, unlike neighbours on clot dissolution, VWF variants, contact/intrinsic activation and F8/F9 defects.
